anti_circularity_note: GT (entity list + per-file char spans) lives only in fixtures/company-estate-manifest.json. The engine path receives only estate files; the manifest is read solely in this scorer to score P2 linking and to enumerate the declared read surface. Nothing GT-shaped enters the engine inputs, seeds, tokens or graph.
zero_egress_note: The entire run (perception, linking, corpus export, graph build) executes with http/https/net/tls/dns/fetch trapped to throw. egressBytes is measured as zero and externalCalls as the empty array; any attempted call aborts the run.

linkMetric.scopeNote: Persons only: the engine has PERSON/EMAIL/PHONE vault classes; org ids and project codenames have no engine class (estate GT only, per the ablation). A GT person carries name + email + phone values, each its own salted engine id; the bridge that matches them is scorer-side under the pinned workspace salt.

entityResolution.note: A salted id is shared across every mention of the same value in every department and modality — that identity IS the cross-department link; the GT manifest only scores it.

srmpRing.note: SR-MP ring anchors resolve repeated, bare-surname and ASR-corrupted mentions across chunks, modalities and departments onto one salted entity id (GC-CRC passes 1–2).

ppr.note: Personalized PageRank over the Dual-CSR perception graph, seeded with a cross-department entity node; a seed "reaches" when a Business-source passage lands in its top-K.

audioCapture.provider: supplied_word_timestamps (no local ASR weights on this CPU box)
audioCapture.note: No local ASR weights on this CPU box: the seam fails closed rather than reaching out. The caption track supplies wordTimestamps exactly as a meeting recorder would — estate capture data, never GT.

receipt.externalCallsNote: Every network entry point above was replaced with a throwing trap for the whole run (perception, linking, corpus export, graph build). A single attempted call aborts the run instead of moving bytes.

fileReads.note: Exhaustive local read surface by construction: the estate corpus files, the GT manifest (scorer-side only), and the three zero-import engine wasm kernels. No other file is read; the engine path writes nothing (outputs are emitted by this scorer after the traps are restored).

export.seamNote: Reuses the Amnesiac Corpus JSONL seam (src/amnesiac-corpus.js buildAmnesiacCorpus) unchanged — no new corpus format. Per-sample certificates ride in the artifact keyed by the sample content-digest id.
